case: a bundle that names no modules
why: A study that activates nothing collects nothing. It would enrol successfully, show a healthy app, and produce an empty dataset that is only noticed at analysis.
The title is what a participant reads when deciding whether they are in the right study, so it cannot be optional.
Closed at the top level so a researcher's typo fails loudly instead of silently leaving the intended setting at its default.
The study identifier seeds the proximity service UUID; a malformed one would silently isolate every device into its own study.

case: a bundle version this schema does not define
why: An app must refuse a bundle it cannot fully interpret rather than apply the parts it recognises.

case: module configuration is not an object
why: A module block is a configuration document. A bare true would leave the module's settings undefined while looking deliberate.
A device asked to sync every ten seconds would drain a participant's battery and achieve nothing the outbox does not already guarantee.
Present but blank is the same failure as absent, and is easier to introduce by templating.

case: a twin that does not say what state it produces
why: Without state_uri the model's output cannot be validated and the app has nothing to check what it receives against.
A server that cannot tell which runtime to use would silently run nothing, which looks exactly like a study where nobody got infected.
A population of zero cannot contain the enrolled participants, so the bundle contradicts itself.
A server cannot guess which economics a study meant; scoring nothing silently is worse than refusing.

case: an unknown key in the rules block
why: Constants belong under `pars`; a stray sibling would be silently ignored and the study would score differently than its author intended.
Without it the first day anchors to whenever the study was registered, so re-registering moves every boundary.
A game that never ends never shows a final score, and the server would keep ticking for ever.
There would be no day one to run, and the app would show progress out of nothing.
A local-looking timestamp is ambiguous by exactly the amount that decides which day a contact fell on.
